ModMetaData.name: Raiders Have Families
ModMetaData.author: Pavuchicha
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.7: real faction-radio prisoner negotiations after arrival at comms console; multi-stage hostage dialogue; proper distinction between ransom amounts and acceptance probability; surgery evidence for WCE2 and vanilla organ harvesting; actual goodwill vs internal faction tension; clickable ransom-delivery notification; ranks 0-8 and social provenance; bounded event-driven AI and dedicated developer test actions with rank-by-click spawns. Experimental v0.12.1: faction-preserving squad roles, bounded support/fire support, physical limited breaching equipment, extraction of unconscious captives, developer audit. Separate dead-hostage radio choices, record-based publicity for murder/execution/cannibalism, genuine search raid followed by coalition reprisal for concealed dead VIPs; old factions/AI used for incident generation. Ideology precepts now show real RHF mood-memory descriptions in the vanilla Mood section, not just appended tooltip prose; no extra automatic thought grants. Experimental family-generation repair (including old-save recheck), protected off-map kin, staged captive/escort exit path, bounded prison-room insertion search, 0–8 office catalogue including Royalty titles, native execution/cannibalism Ideology mood entries, manual and medical-event evidence tracking, conversational variants separated from diagnostic data. Experimental v0.12: actual captive ideology changes and VIP recruitment response, near-slave drops, saved mission doctrines, limited prison barricades, physically loaded field-evacuation skyfaller, bounded industrial targets and traitor pursuit; not a universal combat AI replacement or verified game build. Save backup advised. New experimental faction-recruitment detection and actual Ideology conversion disclosure with group-wide mood gains/losses; multi-phase raids (targeted traitor hunts, breakouts then assault), field fortifications and actual VIP transporter skyfaller. Experimental code, no gameplay confirmation; see REQUIREMENTS_AUDIT_MASTER_RU.md in the source package. Experimental v0.13.0: mission-local coalition identification, safer rescue pod insertion, vanilla PodLauncher/TransportPod field construction with physical supplies and timed builder work, custom raid mission briefing and extraction safeguards. The field departure still uses the existing physical Skyfaller cargo mechanism; full native CompLaunchable launch is not implemented. Build and runtime testing required.
